edits.before: - Bard Cosmic Binding: matchup-defining — The wall-stun starts every Bard pick — never hug terrain near him. It writes your spacing rules. - E-Q stun package is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Bard Cosmic Binding (Q): 11/10/9/8/7s CD — the wall-stun needs terrain, so open lane denies it. - His W shrine has 0s CD, spammable vision/heal. - W-Q stun saves fights, not trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
